raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-STP-YouthEmployment",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Construction of the new training center on Príncipe may be delayed due to procurement and weather-related challenges.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Adopt accelerated procurement, include contingency timelines, use modular construction, and monitor weather forecasts closely.",
      "evidence": "Construction of a new multi-use technical training center... adjustments will be managed within the project’s procurement plan."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Existing training institutions may lack adequate equipment, infrastructure, and staff to deliver quality market‑aligned training.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Upgrade equipment, fund instructor upskilling, provide performance‑based compensation, and monitor capacity against a standardized checklist.",
      "evidence": "Capacity remains constrained... outdated equipment, limited infrastructure, staffing gaps."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "The labor market information system and Employability Portal may not become fully operational, limiting job matching.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Assign dedicated IT staff, pilot test modules, ensure integration with USR and social security databases, and set clear rollout milestones.",
      "evidence": "Employment Observatory never fully operationalized; digital Employability Portal never launched."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Beneficiary selection could exclude the most vulnerable or be captured by elites, reducing equity.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Use USR data for transparent criteria, conduct independent verification, and strengthen the grievance redress mechanism.",
      "evidence": "Risks of exclusion... if project benefits are not equitably distributed, elite capture."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Risk of sexual exploitation, abuse or harassment (SEA/SH) for young women participating in training and internships.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Enforce GBV/SEA policies, provide safe training locations, child‑care support, and a confidential reporting system.",
      "evidence": "Risk of sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) and sexual harassment (SH), particularly for young women."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Delays and weaknesses in financial management could impede timely payments to beneficiaries.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Appoint an experienced accountant, customize the accounting system, conduct regular internal audits, and provide staff capacity building.",
      "evidence": "FM risks identified include delays in recording financial transactions and generating financial reports."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Procurement processes may stall due to insufficient coordination between AFAP and line ministries.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Create a joint procurement task force, define clear TORs and timelines, and conduct coordination workshops.",
      "evidence": "Key factor for good procurement performance will be ability of AFAP and the MLSSS to work in close collaboration."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Climate‑related hazards (floods, storms) could disrupt training delivery and construction activities.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement climate‑resilient designs, install backup generators, schedule activities flexibly, and activate the CERC if needed.",
      "evidence": "STP vulnerable to coastal floods, severe storms... may cause disruptions in service delivery."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Activation of the Contingent Emergency Response Component may be delayed or lack sufficient funds.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Finalize the CERC manual before effectiveness, pre‑identify trigger criteria, and retain a reserve fund for rapid use.",
      "evidence": "CERC manual to be prepared after project effectiveness; activation follows procedures."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Training outputs may not match evolving private‑sector demand, reducing employment outcomes.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Maintain active Workforce Development Committees, use real‑time labor market data to adjust curricula, and conduct quarterly employer surveys.",
      "evidence": "Employers will be engaged in defining priority skills... to review training offerings."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Labor‑mobility pathways could be hindered by policy changes in destination countries such as Portugal.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Diversify destination partnerships, monitor migration policies, and embed flexible MOUs covering multiple jurisdictions.",
      "evidence": "Labor mobility approach depends on partnerships with overseas employers; risk of policy changes."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "The Project Implementation Unit may lack sufficient skilled staff, leading to fragmented execution.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Recruit two senior specialists and two assistants as planned, provide onboarding training, and establish clear reporting lines.",
      "evidence": "PIU will be reinforced with additional consultants; single PIU Coordinator will oversee implementation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Corruption or fraud in grant and stipend disbursements could undermine project credibility.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement electronic payments, conduct independent audits, publish beneficiary lists, and enforce the grievance redress mechanism.",
      "evidence": "Guidelines on Preventing and Combating Fraud and Corruption in Projects will be applied."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Scholarship and grant amounts may be insufficient to cover transport and living costs, causing drop‑outs.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Periodically review cost surveys, adjust stipend levels, and provide additional transport vouchers where needed.",
      "evidence": "Scholarships up to US$1,000; may not fully cover transportation, accommodation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "The new training center may fail to achieve EDGE certification, increasing operational carbon emissions.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Engage certified green‑design consultants, monitor compliance during construction, and install energy‑efficient systems.",
      "evidence": "Aim to meet at least Level 1 of IFC’s EDGE certification."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Delay in completing the impact evaluation could limit learning and evidence generation.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Contract the evaluation firm early, set interim deliverables, and allocate dedicated budget for timely completion.",
      "evidence": "Component 3 will finance an impact evaluation; evaluation to be completed end of project."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "High turnover of newly hired instructors may erode training quality over time.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Offer competitive contracts, continuous professional development, and retention bonuses tied to performance.",
      "evidence": "Need to contract additional instructors; financing instructor upskilling, retraining."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "External economic shocks (fuel price volatility, pandemic resurgence) could reduce private‑sector hiring capacity.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Diversify sector focus, include flexible internship placements, and build resilience through climate‑smart skill training.",
      "evidence": "STP’s economy affected by COVID‑19, fuel and food import cost volatility."
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Construction of the new training center on Príncipe may be delayed due to procurement and weather-related challenges.

risks.evidence: Construction of a new multi-use technical training center... adjustments will be managed within the project’s procurement plan.

risks.description: Existing training institutions may lack adequate equipment, infrastructure, and staff to deliver quality market‑aligned training.

risks.mitigation: Assign dedicated IT staff, pilot test modules, ensure integration with USR and social security databases, and set clear rollout milestones.
risks.evidence: Employment Observatory never fully operationalized; digital Employability Portal never launched.
